text.p: CleveTrust Realty Investors said Thursday the company and some major shareholders have agreed to negotiate the sale of all their shares to RM Crowe Co. for $32.7 million, or $6.42 a share in cash.
The trustees of CleveTrust and certain family members hold directly or indirectly about 70 percent of the company's roughly 5.1 million shares outstanding.

The letter of intent provides that RM Crowe, a closely held commercial real estate property company, has until March 31 to conduct a due diligence investigation, and has the sole discretion to call off the deal on or before that date, CleveTrust said.
If the principal parties execute a definitive agreement, Dallas-based RM Crowe is expected to make a tender offer for all CleveTrust's shares in April, the trust said.
CleveTrust, based in Westlake, Ohio, owns and operates seven buildings, four shopping centres and two retail centres.
CleveTrust's stock rose 37.5 cents to $6 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
